lang_default.description: The primary fallback locale for all LC_* variables if not explicitly set.

lc_collate.description: Locale for string collation and regular expression matching. Empty string leaves it unset or inherits system default.

lc_ctype.description: Locale for character classification, conversion, and wide character functions.

lc_time.description: Locale for time and date formatting.

required_locales.description: List of locale identifiers to make sure are available via localehelper, even if not used by env vars. Uses the -x option syntax internally.
